author: codex:engineering
context: Case literal validity alone did not establish representability in a frozen target version.
decision: Keep preflight pure and reports self-consistent with full case/hash/target. Opt-in script bounds case/report size, requires explicit versions and new output, hides input contents from errors, and never imports a model adapter. Do not alter or resume old claims/runner.

evidence.note: Offline typed contracts, generated schemas and 38 passing synthetic development tests. No provider, generation, reserved migration/reassessment, semantic approval or default promotion.
